title: Feet Particles
description: This mods give a aura type partciles under your feet in red color
body:
This mod adds stylish aura particles 🔴✨ that appear around your feet and back 👣🪽, giving your character a powerful and unique visual effect while moving or standing still 🚶‍♂️⚡. The aura is designed to look clean, smooth, and modern, making it perfect for PvP ⚔️, survival 🌍, or aesthetic-focused gameplay 🎨.

Performance was a top priority while creating this mod 🚀. The particles are lightweight and carefully optimized, so you won’t experience FPS drops or lag 📉❌, even on low-end systems 💻📱. To make things even better, the aura system is fully toggleable 🔁, allowing you to enable or disable it anytime based on your needs.

This ensures you can enjoy the visuals when you want them 👀✨ and turn them off instantly if you’re recording 🎥, playing competitively 🏆, or just want a clean screen 🧼.

The mod is simple to use and does not require complex configuration files ⚙️❌. Everything can be controlled directly in-game using commands ⌨️.

🛠️ Commands:

/feet on – Turns on the aura particles ✅🔥

/feet off – Turns off the aura particles ❌🌫️

Whether you want a subtle glow ✨ or a strong aura presence 🔥😈, this mod delivers visual flair without sacrificing performance ⚡🎮. Perfect for players who want style, control, and efficiency all in one mod 💯💎.
